correctness.rationale: Four tensor-projector eigenvalues 0,p,q,p+q give D,E_p,E_q,F exactly. Independent SymPy/Sturm checks of all seven pq≤12 pairs found no positive diagonal root and only the expected h=0 off-diagonal roots; independent 15-term bivariate shifted-coefficient expansions for (2,7),(3,5),(4,4) have strictly positive coefficients, covering every pq≥13 integer pair by symmetry. F numerator has strictly positive positive-h coefficients; at h=12/(p+q) D is negative above the threshold. The E_m cubic sign at m=37 has the displayed positive quadratic certificate; m=38 has negative witness at z=15 and Descartes gives exactly two positive zeros. Independently evaluated examples: (2,7) negative diagonal -4937/690899; m=37 positive edge 15/2523067 and m=38 negative edge -10/665323 at z=15. Finite evaluations support but do not replace symbolic infinite-parameter proof.
residual_risks: The independent checks use algebraic polynomials and Sturm root counting rather than replaying every original Bernstein-coefficient certificate; those certificates were read at algorithm level in the source, not executed unchanged.
The result does not characterize all adjacent-sign intervals for nonsquare p≠q, nor stagewise/nonlinear positivity.

value.rationale: Rook graphs are natural two-factor lattice/line graphs, and the exact all-time stochasticity frontier pq=12 separates a Markov transition from an unphysical negative heat step. The independent 37/38 adjacent entry cutoff exposes a second sign mechanism even where diagonal positivity already fails; this is a motivated exact infinite-parameter classification, not a small numerical improvement.
residual_risks: Only completed endpoint Radau IIA and unit weights; no universal SSP promise.

final_claim: For K_p square K_q, p,q≥2, completed Radau IIA update R(hL) is entrywise nonnegative for every h≥0 iff pq≤12; distance-two entries are positive for h>0; for square p=q=m adjacent transitions have a unique negative h-band exactly when m≥38.
